findings.title: Frozen public delivery includes private filesystem references
findings.evidence: Candidate public_guard.check_paths on all 10 delivery files, 14 engineering receipts and manifest rejected this manifest-bound browser results file with SECRET_OR_PRIVATE_REFERENCE; remaining 24 paths passed.
findings.impact: Installing and publicly delivering all frozen evidence would expose private workstation path references and violate the existing public guard.
findings.required_change: Preserve frozen v1. Generate a separate sanitized public browser receipt using project-relative paths, retaining equivalent counts/results and original private evidence locally; produce a new frozen manifest/version and independently recheck every delivery and evidence path. Do not patch the frozen v1 in place.

evidence.probe_development_note: Initial generic attack loop also targeted ordinary daily evidence, where changing a permitted license can legitimately remain exact-public. Scope corrected to the fixed exceptional decision; both actual roots still included in positive restore. This was a probe assumption error, not a candidate permit bypass.

functional_review: Full actual decision read; fixed ID/hash, extra actual_net only and identity check is None retain exact one-original permit. Explicit export_fields, visibility/license changes, non-null values including false/zero/string/array/object, nested fields and promotion mutations reject.

Recomputed ZIP member/original/manifest hashes cannot grant an exception. Noncanonical bytes and duplicate-key variants reject before restore destination creation. Prior numeraire/calendar/Roll permits remain unchanged.

Complete source, delivery and engineering receipt hashes verified. Independent publish.py --source-hash matches candidate. Only archive.py, App.tsx and new DocumentLibrary.tsx differ; old16/formal19, public data loader and schema/contracts unchanged.

DocumentLibrary scans at most 10 current catalog references sequentially with 1 MB limit, records failures and incomplete coverage, and lists at most 20 matches before explicit expansion. Abort and mounted guards prevent stale writes; keyed snapshot remount isolates changed snapshots. Current snapshot immutable identity justifies unchanged-key refresh reuse.

Two real snapshot local replays in both browsers reached discovery/evidence and verified attachments, preserved PROPOSED_NOT_STARTED and graph viewport/count. Synthetic bounded/cancel/failure/refresh checks passed. These are local engineering replays, not Pages evidence.

Independent browser probes in both engines additionally rejected cache size, missing current catalog membership, historical as_of, aborted cache requests and unsafe paths; unchanged explicit related-record association rules passed. Record bodies use existing verified loader and attachment renderer.
